description: A stereo saturator with seven distortion characters, a limiter on the way out, and a puffer fish that shows how hard it is being driven

params.text: Picks the distortion character: BLOOM, SPINE, FRENZY, RIPTIDE, VOID, SWARM or TEETH; linked it sets both halves of the waveform, unlinked it shapes only the part below zero
Sets how hard the signal is driven into the saturation, none at the far left, and starts a quarter of the way up
Adjusts the level going into the saturation without changing the level coming out, 6dB quieter at the far left and 6dB louder at the far right, and starts at the centre where it does nothing
Sets how much of the voltage at the PUFF jack is added to the PUFF knob, and reverses its sign anticlockwise of centre; at centre the jack does nothing
Crossfades between the signal arriving at the inputs and the saturated signal, dry at the far left and saturated only at the far right, where it starts
Picks the distortion character used on the part of the signal above zero: BLOOM, SPINE, FRENZY, RIPTIDE, VOID, SWARM or TEETH; while the two are linked this control is overwritten by the other one
Makes the two character selectors follow each other, so one distortion shapes the whole waveform; unlinked, the halves of the waveform are shaped differently, and it starts linked
Sets how far from the module the fish may wander while roaming, a short leash at the far left and most of a screen at the far right
Steps through the limiter on the outputs: hard, soft, then off, and it starts on hard; the lamps beside it say which is chosen
Lets the fish leave the panel and swim about the rack, avoiding the mouse pointer and other Puffies; it starts off and nothing about the sound changes

inputs.text: The left channel of the signal to be saturated; with nothing patched into IN R this signal is sent to both channels
The right channel of the signal to be saturated; with nothing patched into IN L this signal is sent to both channels
Adds to the PUFF knob through the attenuverter beside it, ten volts covering the whole knob at its full setting

outputs.text: The left channel of the mix of dry and saturated signal, after the limiter
The right channel of the mix of dry and saturated signal, after the limiter

notes: with nothing patched into either input the module puts out silence; the fish is drawn and reacts to the controls all the same
the fish is a meter: how far it inflates shows the drive reaching the saturation, how it moves shows the swing of the input, and its blush shows the limiter pulling the level down
the fish picture and the waveform panel below it are drawn widgets, not controls, and no click on either reaches a note of its own
menu: Roaming Mode — the same switch the roam button makes, letting the fish swim out of the panel and about the rack
Auto Deflate — pulls the output level down as PUFF is raised, by an amount fixed per character, so turning up the drive does not also turn up the volume

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the jack beside it.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the jack beside it.
inputs.2:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
